t: Fireplace Logs fit perfectly with Merry Mantels. They have a directional facing and can be lit with a Flint and Steel, or doused with a Bucket of Water. $(br2)Fireplace logs can also be connected to Redstone if desired. $(br2)The recipe for the Fireplace Logs follows:
